background_equations.acceleration_identity: ddot(a)/a=-(rho_E+rho_s+3*p_E+3*p_s)/(6*M_Pl^2); acceleration requires the total rho+3p to be negative but is not established
background_equations.constraint_propagation: Differentiating Friedmann and using total continuity yields Raychaudhuri wherever H!=0; the independent spatial Einstein equation supplies it without dividing by H
background_equations.covariant_specialization: E_phi=nabla_mu(C*nabla^mu phi)-V_phi=Q_phi and E_chi=Y0*box(chi)-m_chi^2*Z*chi=Q_chi specialize to the displayed Euler equations because box(f)=-(ddot(f)+3*H*dot(f))

conventions.cosmic_time_gauge: N=1 only after lapse variation; H=dot(a)/a and dots in displayed background equations use Einstein-frame cosmic time
conventions.kinetic_invariants: X=dot(phi)^2/(2*N^2)>=0 and X_chi=dot(chi)^2/(2*N^2)>=0 on the homogeneous branch
conventions.scalar_lagrangian: L_s=P(X)-V(phi)+Y0*X_chi-Q*Z(X), with Q=m_chi^2*chi^2/2, Y0>0, and Z=(1+u)^2, u=beta*X^2
conventions.source_sign: Q_i=-(partial_i ln A)*T_E and predecessor E_i=Q_i; multiplying the homogeneous covariant scalar equation by -1 puts +(partial_i ln A)*T_E on the minisuperspace Euler right-hand side
conventions.universal_metric: tilde_g_mu_nu=A(phi,chi)^2*g_mu_nu with A>0 and finite; alpha_phi=partial_phi ln A and alpha_chi=partial_chi ln A

gate_limits_and_necessary_conditions.cutoff_and_perturbations: The EFT cutoff must exceed H, scalar time scales, masses, and mixing scales, and the full scalar-metric-matter perturbation system must be ghost-free, gradient-stable, and hyperbolic; none is established here
gate_limits_and_necessary_conditions.exact_gate_energy_factor: Z-2*X*Z_X=(1+u)*(1-7*u), so the mass-gate contribution to rho_s changes sign at u=1/7
gate_limits_and_necessary_conditions.friedmann_reality: rho_E+rho_s>=0 is necessary for real H in flat FLRW
gate_limits_and_necessary_conditions.high_u: At fixed nonzero chi and finite beta, rho_gate~-7*Q*u^2, p_gate~-Q*u^2, and (rho+p)_gate~-8*Q*u^2; a nonnegative Friedmann right-hand side therefore requires compensating P, V, kinetic, or matter terms and is not automatic
gate_limits_and_necessary_conditions.history_consistency: One parameter set and initial condition set must solve Friedmann, the independent spatial Einstein equation, both scalar equations, matter exchange, and constraint propagation on the same interval
gate_limits_and_necessary_conditions.regularity: A, P, P_X, P_XX, V, Z, Z_X, Z_XX, C, K, H, phi, chi, and their required time derivatives must remain finite on the claimed interval
gate_limits_and_necessary_conditions.timelike_local_health: Necessary predecessor scalar conditions include Y0>0, Z>0, C>0, and K=C+2*X*C_X=P_X+2*X*P_XX-Q*(Z_X+2*X*Z_XX)>0 on every realized homogeneous background
gate_limits_and_necessary_conditions.x_zero: As X->0, u->0, Z->1, Z_X->0, C->P_X(0), the gate contribution becomes rho_gate=+Q and p_gate=-Q, and the direct mass-gate term leaves rho_gate+p_gate=0

limitations: These are exact homogeneous flat-FLRW equations for the frozen action, not proof that a physical cosmological history exists.
The high-u negative gate-energy term is an obstruction requiring compensation, not an unconditional no-go theorem.
Background C>0 and K>0 are necessary local scalar conditions, not the full constrained perturbation analysis.
Conformal cone alignment is structural; no observational GW or photon propagation pass is claimed.
No observational rows, network, model calls, likelihood, fit, novelty, or publication claim is present.

matter_exchange_contract.constant_w_solution: For a separately conserved physical perfect fluid with constant w, rho_E is proportional to A^(1-3*w)*a^[-3*(1+w)]
matter_exchange_contract.dust_probe: w=0 gives T_E=-rho_E, rho_E proportional to A*a^-3, Q_i=+alpha_i*rho_E, and matter continuity dot(rho_E)+3*H*rho_E=rho_E*dot(ln A)
matter_exchange_contract.physical_frame: With d(tilde_t)=A*dt, tilde_a=A*a, and tilde_H=(H+dot(ln A))/A, physical conservation is d(tilde_rho)/d(tilde_t)+3*tilde_H*(tilde_rho+tilde_p)=0
matter_exchange_contract.radiation_probe: w=1/3 gives T_E=0, rho_E proportional to a^-4, and no classical conformal scalar source or exchange
matter_exchange_contract.scalar_continuity: dot(rho_s)+3*H*(rho_s+p_s)=T_E*dot(ln A) after both scalar equations
matter_exchange_contract.vacuum_probe: w=-1 gives T_E=-4*rho_E and rho_E proportional to A^4 when tilde_rho is constant; this is a conformally coupled vacuum component, not a demonstrated accelerating solution

remaining_blockers: Freeze P(X), V(phi), A(phi,chi), all parameters, the EFT cutoff, and initial conditions without post-result choices.
Prove a regular solution exists over a declared interval and preserves Friedmann plus the independent spatial constraint.
Show whether the negative high-u gate-energy contribution is dynamically avoided or consistently compensated without violating C>0 and K>0.
Derive the complete scalar-metric-matter quadratic action and establish ghost, gradient, hyperbolicity, and strong-coupling control.
Demonstrate acceleration rather than merely satisfying its necessary rho+3p inequality.
Preregister and pass BBN, CMB, expansion-history, growth, Solar, GW, and lensing tests using one parameter set.
Any disformal extension requires a new action-level derivation plus the inherited q interval; it is not validated here.

stress_energy_contract.lapse_route: With X_N=dot(phi)^2/(2*N^2) and X_chi,N=dot(chi)^2/(2*N^2), rho_s=-(1/a^3)*partial[N*a^3*L_s(X_N,X_chi,N)]/partial N evaluated at N=1
stress_energy_contract.scale_route: p_s=(1/(3*N*a^2))*partial[N*a^3*L_s]/partial a=L_s because the homogeneous scalar Lagrangian has no explicit a dependence

tensor_photon_and_disformal_contract.conformal_branch: The Einstein-Hilbert tensor principal cone is g-null and positive finite A leaves the universal photon cone identical, so c_GW/c_gamma=1 locally on the homogeneous conformal branch; this is structural, not an observational or full-characteristic pass
tensor_photon_and_disformal_contract.disformal_scope: A disformal extension is not part of the committed split-gate conformal action and is probed only as an inherited necessary alternative-branch condition
tensor_photon_and_disformal_contract.inherited_speed_threshold: Using only the predecessor-frozen delta_G=1/1000000000000000, |Delta^(-1/2)-1|<=delta_G requires 1-(1-delta_G)^(-2)<=q<=1-(1+delta_G)^(-2)
